main.description: Space policy for group spaces: each role's access and permissions in the space, whether it is public, and whether it is listed in the space index. The host always publishes it in the space as a com.atproto.space.policy record.

publicRead.description: If true, anyone may read the space.

unlisted.description: If true, the host leaves the space out of the group's space index. Ignored for the meta and members spaces.

grants.description: At most one entry per role.

grant.description: A role's grants in one space. read and write apply to members acting as themselves; permissions apply to acting as the group.

read.description: If true, members with this role may read the space.

write.description: If true, members with this role are in the space's writer set, so their own records sync to readers.

permissions.description: Permissions for acting as the group in this space, one per item.
